name: sensor-sim-api
description: Controlled IoT sensor simulator for smart campus/facility dashboard (power + water).

scripts.test:syntax: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),vm=require('vm');function c(d){fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).forEach(e=>{const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory()&&e.name!=='node_modules'&&e.name!=='.git')c(p);else if(e.isFile()&&e.name.endsWith('.js'))new vm.Script(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'),{filename:p});});}c('./src');c('./test');console.log('Static syntax check passed across all JS files.');"
